verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents connecting multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts, switching between them without changing apps, and a consolidated calendar view across those accounts. It is explicitly positioned as 'built for teams that use Gmail or Outlook', and nothing in the evidence shows IMAP support, so one of the story's three providers is not covered. Missing for 10: IMAP/other-provider support, evidence of a unified cross-account inbox (rather than switching between accounts), independent hands-on corroboration of multi-account use.
